strategy_rules: Daily bet = the two highest-confidence picks parlayed, but ONLY when BOTH clear 65% model win probability
If fewer than two picks clear 65%, bet the single best pick instead (so there is always daily action)
Parlay legs ranked by confidence then model probability — NOT market edge/EV (prediction-first)
Validated on the live walk-forward with real closing odds + $10 compound bankroll:
full season 56% hit, $10->$168, never below $8.20; last 30 days 60% hit, +40%/bet
calibrated: combined model probability ~55% == 56% actual hit rate
Two ~65% picks parlay to ~50% combined — wins more than half the time and pays ~2x to grow bankroll
Rejected: naive top-2 parlay (45% hit, bled bankroll) and 3-leg (36% hit, too brutal for small roll)
Track accuracy on /accuracy and season walk-forward record
